messages:
Zoey: Smoke onboarding zeno-v1 (int4 compact) — quick flag: mixed CJK+RTL samples show invisible chars inserted between Han and ruby/furigana or unexpected bracket mirroring in Hebrew fragments. FP16 baseline fine. BLEU drop ~6 on srt-multilang. Anyone seen compaction/hash collisions cause invisible token output?

Rui: Can you paste a minimal repro and tokenizer dumps? Also the quant args used.

Zoey: Repro: `./onboard --model zeno-v1 --quant int4 --calib per_channel --quant-hash=fnv --dataset srt-multilang --langs ja,zh,he --detok unicode`
Sample: fp16 detok: "\u7ae0\u30d5\u30ea\u30ac\u30ca"; int4 detok: "\u7ae0\u200b\u30d5\u30ea\u30ac\u30ca" (U+200B inserted). Hex dump shows 0xE2 0x80 0x8B inserted. Also Hebrew bracket ordering flips in other samples.

Ana: Sounds like tokenmap assignment issue or normalization step toggled. Try `--tokenizer-normalize=NFKC` and re-gen table with `--quant-hash=xxh3 --quant-salt=11`. If hash/salt flips behavior it's collision.

Zoey: Quick try: NFKC removed many ZWSP cases but BLEU still down ~3. Regen with xxh3+salt=11 removed ZWSP and bracket flipping in our small set. Filed ML-4033 with repro + tokenmap. For safety I've excluded zeno-v1_int4 from auto-promote until we confirm regen is stable.

eval-bot: Snapshot: fp16 BLEU 41.0 -> int4 BLEU 35.0 (post-regenerate xxh3: 40.6).

Rui: Good triage. Add a deterministic mixed-script sample to the quant smoke harness (kanji+furigana + RTL snippet) so future compaction changes can't regress silently.

Zoey: Added test and CI gate. Will follow up after full-grid confirms stability.
